01001.name: Roland Banks
01001.text:
[reaction] After you defeat an enemy: Discover 1 clue at your location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each clue on your location.

01006.name: Roland's .38 Special
01006.text: Roland Banks deck only. Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack (if there are 1 or more clues on your location, you get +3 [combat], instead). This attack deals +1 damage.

01020.name: Machete
01020.text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. If the attacked enemy is the only enemy engaged with you, this attack deals +1 damage.

01023.name: Dodge
01023.text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack.

01028.name: Beat Cop
01028.text:
You get +1 [combat].
[fast] Exhaust Beat Cop and deal 1 damage to it: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.

01039.name: Deduction
01039.text: If this skill test is successful while investigating a location, discover 1 additional clue at that location.

01040.name: Magnifying Glass
01040.text:
Fast.
You get +1 [intellect] while investigating.
[fast] If there are no clues on your location: Return Magnifying Glass to your hand.

01090.name: Perception
01090.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card.

01144.name: The Ritual Begins
01144.text: Each enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade.

01149.name: Main Path
01149.text: The Main Path is connected to each other [[Woods]] location. [action]: Resign. "There's nothing we can do to stop them!" You flee from the woods, leaving Arkham to its grisly fate.

01164.name: Frozen in Fear
01164.text: Revelation - Put Frozen in Fear into play in your threat area. The first time you perform one of the following actions (move, fight, or evade) each round, it costs 1 additional action. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Frozen in Fear.

01176.name: The Yellow Sign
01176.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, take 2 horror and search your deck for a [[Madness]] weakness. Draw that card and shuffle your deck.

50033.name: Arkham Woods
50033.text: Forced - After an investigator at this location succeeds at a skill test on a treachery: That treachery gains surge. (Group limit once per round.)

50034.name: Arkham Woods
50034.text: Forced - After you reveal a chaos token from the chaos bag while investigating this location: Reveal and resolve an additional chaos token. (Limit once per test.)

50035.name: Arkham Woods
50035.text: Each enemy at this location cannot take more than 1 damage from each attack performed against it.

50036.name: Arkham Woods
50036.text: Forced - After you reveal a chaos token from the chaos bag during an evasion attempt at this location: Reveal and resolve an additional chaos token. (Limit once per test.)

50042.name: Corpse-Taker
50042.text:
Spawn - Farthest empty location.
Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Place 1 doom on Corpse-Taker.
Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Corpse-Taker moves once toward Rivertown or Main Path. If Corpse-Taker is already at Rivertown or Main Path, move all doom from Corpse-Taker to the current agenda, instead.
